data.title: Nvidia is bolstering support for Chinese open AI models as it warns of White House crackdown
data.description: Nvidia is optimizing hardware for DeepSeek and Qwen while warning that potential U.S. restrictions on models originating in China could hurt its business.
data.author: Kai Nicol-Schwarz
